Highly variable (several days collecting items; the lottery depends on luck)

The Summoner Outfit is available to any Premium player; this quest gives you both addons. Men get the Fluid Belt in {npc:Sandra}'s vial lottery (Edron) and the second addon by helping {npc:Myra} in Port Hope. Women get the Wand through {npc:Lynda}'s ritual (Thais) and the Hat by handing in {item:Ferumbras' Hat} to {npc:Zoltan}. With the full outfit you get the achievement **Ritualist** (male) or **Alumni** (female).
Great for young mages and ladies who love witchcraft. If you're after addons, gentlemen should take a stroll around Port Hope, while ladies should explore the Dark Cathedral.
Premium Account (the base outfit belongs to all Premium players; the quest only gives the addons).
No minimum level; 60–200 recommended because of the creatures you have to hunt.
The addons depend on the character's sex: men do Fluid Belt + Myra's addon; women do Wand + Hat.
**Fluid Belt (male):** at least 100 {item:Vial|empty vials} per ticket, or a {item:Winning Lottery Ticket}

**Myra's addon (male):** 70 {item:Bat Wing}, 20 {item:Red Piece of Cloth}, 40 {item:Ape Fur}, 35 {item:Holy Orchid}, 10 {item:Spool of Yarn}, 60 {item:Lizard Scale}, 40 {item:Red Dragon Scale}, 15 ounces of {item:Magic Sulphur} and 30 ounces of {item:Vampire Dust}
**Wand (female):** the 5 old wands and 5 old rods, 10 ounces of {item:Magic Sulphur}, 1 {item:Soul Stone} and 20 {item:Ankh|Ankhs}
Gather all of Myra's items **before** talking to her: you can hand them all in one after another.
Sandra's lottery is pure luck: you'll usually lose. Keep saving empty vials while you hunt.

The Mage and Summoner addons are swapped between sexes. If you change the character's sex, you receive the matching addon on the other outfit, **except** the Hat: you can't get it by doing the female Mage or the male Summoner and then changing sex.
Sandra, in Edron, exchanges empty vials for lottery tickets. Each ticket costs 100 empty vials and some of them give the belt addon.

Go to {npc:Sandra}'s shop in Edron with at least 100 {item:Vial|empty vials}. Say {key:hi}, {key:vial}, {key:yes} and {key:yes} again to sign up for the bonus system. (If you declined before, just say {key:bonus}.) Sandra's shop is in the Ivory Towers, in the east part of Edron; if you're not in Edron, take a boat there ({key:hi}, {key:edron}, {key:yes}).
Male Summoner with the Fluid Belt
With 100 or more empty vials, say {key:vial} and {key:yes} to receive a lottery ticket instead of the deposit. The result is random: most of the time you lose. Repeat until you win.
With a {item:Winning Lottery Ticket}, say {key:hi}, {key:prize} and {key:yes}. You receive the belt addon. If you want to leave the bonus system, say {key:bonus} and {key:yes}.
Myra, in Port Hope, received a tiara from the Edron academy. If you bring her lots of magical ingredients, she nominates you and Zoltan gives you the addon.
Gather everything before you start. This is the list, in hand-in order, and where to get each item:
Exchange {item:Red Robe|Red Robes} with {npc:Irmana} in Venore, or hunt {creature:Hero|Heroes}, {wiki:Barbarians} and {creature:Infernalist|Infernalists}
Give {item:Spider Silk} and 50 {item:Honeycomb|Honeycombs} to the mermaid {npc:Marina} in Meriana
{creature:Brimstone Bug|Brimstone Bugs}, or by giving {item:Fire Sword|Fire Swords} to the magic-shop Djinns in the Djinn towers

Go to **Port Hope** and talk to {npc:Myra} (1 floor up). Say {key:hi}, {key:outfit}, {key:tiara}, {key:yes} and {key:yes} again to accept the task. To get to Port Hope, tell the port captain {key:hi}, {key:port hope}, {key:yes}.
Hand in the items one by one

Hand in each item in order, saying the keyword and {key:yes}: {key:bat wings}, {key:red cloth}, {key:ape fur}, {key:holy orchids}, {key:spider silk yarn}, {key:lizard scales}, {key:red dragon scales}, {key:magic sulphur} and {key:vampire dust}. At the end, when she asks if you want the reward, say {key:yes}.
Go to the **Edron** academy and talk to {npc:Zoltan} (3 floors above ground). Say {key:hi} and {key:Myra}. He gives you the addon.

The {wiki:Dark Cathedral} is **south** of the Outlaw Camp and **west** of the Plains of Havoc, south of the Venore swamp. Leave Thais through the **east** gate (or Venore through the west gate) and cross the plains to get there (beware of {creature:Giant Spider|Giant Spiders} lured to the centre of the plains). Go down the stairs **2 floors**.

On the 2nd floor, from the stairs, keep going **south** to a big room: the teleport to the 3rd floor is at the far end of it. Before you enter, pull the **6 levers** in the 5 rooms around the big room and then step into the teleport.

There is a time limit for pulling the levers (between 30 seconds and 2.5 minutes, according to the wiki). Do one round to kill the creatures and another just to pull the levers, or split them among the team.
Go to the **Dark Cathedral**. Next to the teleport that leads out of it you'll find {npc:Angelina}. Say {key:hi} and {key:yes}: she sends you to her friend {npc:Lynda}, in Thais.
On the way for this addon there are {wiki:Monks}, {creature:Necropharus} and, for the Hat, {creature:Ferumbras}.
If the door to Angelina's cell is locked, {item:Key 5050} is in a box in the room **west** of hers.
Step into the teleport next to {npc:Angelina}: it takes you out of the Dark Cathedral. Then walk back **west** across the plains to Thais.
Go to **Thais** and talk to {npc:Lynda}. Say {key:hi}, {key:Angelina}, {key:yes} and {key:yes}. She asks you for the ingredients for the blessing spell.
Bring the 5 rods and 5 wands **all at once** and say {key:wands} and {key:yes}.
Say {key:magic sulphur} and {key:yes} to hand in 10 ounces of {item:Magic Sulphur}.
Say {key:soul stone} and {key:yes} to hand in the {item:Soul Stone} (Lynda calls it "the Necromancer's soul stone").
Say {key:ankhs} and {key:yes} to hand in 20 {item:Ankh|Ankhs}. Lynda starts the ritual.
Wait **3 hours** for the ritual to take effect. Then come back and say {key:ritual}. If the time hasn't passed yet, she answers "Please let me focus for a while".

{creature:Ferumbras} appears in the {wiki:Ferumbras Citadel|Ferumbras Citadel}, on the island of {wiki:Kharos|Kharos}, west of Liberty Bay. You need the Kharos access from {wiki:The Shattered Isles Quest|The Shattered Isles Quest} and permission from {npc:Zoltan} in Edron ({key:permission}, 500 gp per entry; first you have to step on the citadel's energy wall). In Liberty Bay, {npc:Jack Fate} takes you to Goroma ({key:hi}, {key:goroma}, {key:yes}); use the {wiki:Teleportation Hub|Teleportation Hub} to Malada and go down the trapdoor to the **south**. The trapdoor only works for going down.

When you enter the citadel you're greeted by several {creature:Behemoth|Behemoths} and maybe lured {creature:Demon|Demons} and {creature:Dragon Lord|Dragon Lords}. Below level ~150, stand against the wall and don't move until everything around you is dead.
The **only** way to get this hat is to kill {creature:Ferumbras} and pick up the {item:Ferumbras' Hat} from his remains.

After you pass the barrier you can't leave through it. To leave, go **east**, go down a hole, head **west** and go up a rope hole (you need the {item:Rope}). Then leave Kharos through the one-way teleport to Goroma (in the hole to the **east**) and return to Liberty Bay with {npc:Jack Fate} ({key:hi}, {key:passage}, {key:yes}).
Go to the Edron academy and talk to {npc:Zoltan}. Say {key:hi}, {key:proof} and {key:yes}.
With both addons, you earn the **Ritualist** (male) or **Alumni** (female) achievement.

The {wiki:Mage Outfits|Mage Outfit} and Summoner addons are swapped between sexes: the male Mage's Wand and Hat correspond to the female Summoner; the Fluid Belt and the Tiara belong to the male Summoner and the female Mage.
If you complete the Mage on a female character and switch to male, you end up with the complete Summoner.
